target: binary final recorded log10-risk >= -6; not physical Pc
precision: float32 CPU; preprocessing and stored metrics float64
preprocessing: Each fit uses only its training prefixes, shared policy across arms: phi age categories, median imputation, RobustScaler, per-message missing flags; latest arm slices after fitting this same prefix preprocessor.
masking: Packed sequences exclude padded steps from both recurrence and final hidden state.
objective: BCE; each scenario totals one unit across variants; uniform shuffled row batches estimate normalized weighted objective using fixed population mean row weight; no class balancing.
candidate_selection: Minimum weighted inner OOF clipped log loss; tie by smaller width then fewer epochs; six fresh candidates, no early stopping or warm starts.
calibration: Existing monotone Platt and nominal 95% training-recall threshold on selected inner OOF; reused for selection/calibration/threshold, no risk guarantee.
fit_seed: trial seed + fold index for inner fits; trial seed for selected refit; matched across arms/candidates; minibatch seed is fit seed + 1000000
evaluation: software and bias_stress; all seven conditions; 224000 rows, 1000 paired scenarios per bank, not independent rows or seed replications
failure_policy: Any nonfinite objective/gradient/prediction, failed calibration, incompatible reference, or failed invariant stops the run; retain partial candidate scores, fit records/checkpoints and failure category. Never drop a failed candidate or reduce grid after seeing results. New run ID for retry.
budget_scope: Same six candidate count as logistic/proxy controls, different capacity and optimizer/compute budget. No SOTA or published-method reproduction claim.
